page.layout: One page of text: title and dedication at full width above; below them a text block with a woodcut initial at left, text to its right running down and continuing beneath the woodcut at full width. Page number at foot centre-left, catchword-like line at foot right.

main_text.l: Lornæ, &c. Summo Architriclino Regio, Et summo
Lornæ, Ejus Filio natu Maximo, Et
esse: Sed Pauci res ipsas probè intel-
tem in ulla re, præterquam in unius
runt, illi etiam in Sapientiæ negotio
mum vera est Sapientia, per quam ad solidam, æternamque felicitatem,
rectâ certoque ducimur. Tristissimum est spectaculum,

page.notes: Woodcut initial "S" within an ornamental woodcut border at left of the text block. Manuscript annotations in the margins (ink scribbles near the title lines) are handwriting and were omitted. The running head is absent on this opening page. Long s rendered as s throughout.
